record.one_liner: Attio is a customizable, data-model-flexible CRM for managing contacts, companies, deals and custom objects, with lists, notes, tasks and email/meeting sync.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code (workspace-level tokens by default; user-level tokens need PKCE) for multi-workspace apps. A single-workspace access token (API key) generated in developer settings. Both sent as Bearer; Basic (token as username) is also accepted but Bearer is recommended.
record.access_notes: Attio's help center says API access is available on all plans, including Free (up to 3 seats). Per search snippets (not fetched from the vendor), a token is created in Settings > Developers. Publishing shared OAuth apps uses the build.attio.com developer dashboard. I did not fetch that page or sign up. Third-party sources conflict on whether a separate developer workspace must be requested.
record.blocker: none. Minor caveats: rate limits apply (the MCP docs list 100 read/s and 25 write/s per workspace, and the REST limits page was not fetched). The MCP SQL tool is not on every plan. Breadth is rated broad based on the MCP coverage list; the REST endpoint reference was not fetched.
